en.s: An interregnum and a war of succession began in the Kingdom of Portugal in 1383 when King Ferdinand I died leaving no sons and ended when King John I was crowned in 1385 after his victory during the Battle of Aljubarrota. The Portuguese interpret the era as their earliest national resistance movement to counter Castilian intervention, and Robert Durand considers it as the "great revealer of national consciousness".

zh.s: 1383年，葡萄牙国王费尔南多一世去世，未留下儿子，葡萄牙王国因此进入空位期并爆发王位继承战争。1385年，若昂一世在阿尔茹巴罗塔战役中获胜并加冕，战争随之结束。葡萄牙人将这段时期视为本国最早抵抗卡斯蒂利亚干预的民族运动；罗伯特·迪朗则称其为“民族意识的伟大发现者”。

en.t: Having spotted land on March 27, Spanish explorer Juan Ponce de León comes ashore on what is now the U.S. state of Florida, landing somewhere between the modern city of St. Augustine and the mouth of the St. Johns River
en.s: Juan Ponce de León (c. 1474 – July 1521) was a Spanish explorer and conquistador known for leading the first European expeditions to Puerto Rico in 1508 and Florida in 1513. He was born in Santervás de Campos, Valladolid, Spain, in 1474. Though little is known about his family, he was of noble birth and served in the Spanish military from a young age.

zh.t: 西班牙探险家胡安·庞塞·德莱昂发现陆地后，于3月27日上岸，登陆地点位于今美国佛罗里达州圣奥古斯丁市与圣约翰斯河口之间某处
zh.s: 胡安·庞塞·德莱昂（约1474年—1521年7月）是西班牙探险家和征服者，以1508年和1513年率领欧洲人首次远征波多黎各和佛罗里达而闻名。他于1474年出生在西班牙巴利亚多利德省圣特尔瓦斯-德坎波斯。关于他的家世所知不多，但他出身贵族，年少时便在西班牙军队服役。

en.s: The First French War of Religion (2 April 1562 – 19 March 1563) was the opening civil war of the French Wars of Religion. The war began when, in response to the massacre of Wassy by the duc de Guise (duke of Guise), the prince de Condé seized Orléans on 2 April.

zh.t: 第一次法国宗教战争（1562—1563年）
zh.s: 第一次法国宗教战争（1562年4月2日—1563年3月19日）是法国宗教战争中的第一场内战。吉斯公爵屠杀瓦西事件后，孔代亲王于1562年4月2日夺取奥尔良，战争由此爆发。

en.s: The French Wars of Religion (French: Guerres de Religion en France) were a series of civil wars between French Catholics and Protestants (called Huguenots) from 1562 to 1598. Between two and four million people died from violence, famine or disease directly caused by the conflict, and it severely damaged the power of the French monarchy.

zh.s: 法国宗教战争（法语：Guerres de Religion en France）是1562年至1598年间法国天主教徒与新教徒（胡格诺派）之间的一系列内战。冲突直接导致200万至400万人死于暴力、饥荒或疾病，并严重削弱了法国君主制的权力。

en.s: The Battle of Bhupalgarh (also spelled Bhupalgad) was fought between the Mughal Empire and Maratha Kingdom in 1679, near present day Khanapur, in a leadup to the Deccan wars. The Maratha were led by Shivaji, the first Maratha king. The battle resulted in the razing of the fort of Bhupalgarh and a decisive victory for the Mughals under general Diler Khan.

zh.s: 1679年，莫卧儿帝国与马拉塔王国在今卡纳普尔附近爆发布帕尔加尔（又称布帕尔加德）战役，战事发生于德干战争前夕。马拉塔军由首位马拉塔国王希瓦吉率领。战役以莫卧儿军获胜、迪莱尔汗将军攻陷并摧毁布帕尔加尔堡告终。

en.t: J. S. Bach's cantata Bleib bei uns, denn es will Abend werden, BWV 6, is first performed in Leipzig on Easter Monday
en.s: Bleib bei uns, denn es will Abend werden (Stay with us, for evening falls), BWV 6, is a cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for use in a Lutheran service. He composed it in Leipzig in 1725 for Easter Monday and first performed it on 2 April 1725. The prescribed readings for the feast day were Peter's sermon from the Acts of the Apostles, and the Road to Emmaus narration from the Gospel of Luke.

zh.t: J·S·巴赫康塔塔《求你留下，因为天色已晚》首演
zh.s: 《求你留下，因为天色已晚》（Bleib bei uns, denn es will Abend werden，BWV 6）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为路德宗礼拜创作的康塔塔。他于1725年在莱比锡为复活节星期一创作此曲，并于1725年4月2日首演。当天的指定经文包括《使徒行传》中彼得的讲道，以及《路加福音》中前往以马忤斯的叙述。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 2, 1781. John Hancock, the incumbent governor, defeated James Bowdoin, the former president of the Massachusetts Constitutional Convention.

zh.s: 1781年4月2日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长约翰·汉考克击败州制宪会议前主席詹姆斯·鲍登。

en.s: The 1783 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1783, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Independent governor William Greene won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 2, 1787. John Hancock, who had served as the first governor of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts from 1780 to 1785, defeated James Bowdoin, the incumbent governor. The election took place in the aftermath of Shays's Rebellion, for which Bowdoin was sharply censured.

zh.s: 1787年4月2日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。曾于1780年至1785年担任该州首任州长的约翰·汉考克，击败现任州长詹姆斯·鲍登。选举发生在谢司起义之后，鲍登因应对起义的做法受到严厉批评。

en.s: The 1788 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1788, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Independent governor John Collins won the election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1788年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。独立派现任州长约翰·柯林斯因无竞争对手而获胜。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: The 1792 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1792, in order to elect the Governor of Massachusetts. Incumbent Governor John Hancock won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1792年4月2日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长约翰·汉考克因无竞争对手而连任。

en.t: The Coinage Act is passed by Congress, establishing the United States Mint
en.s: The United States Mint is a bureau of the Department of the Treasury responsible for producing coinage for the United States to conduct its trade and commerce, as well as controlling the movement of bullion. The U.S. Mint is one of two U.S. agencies that manufactures physical money. The other is the Bureau of Engraving and Printing, which prints paper currency.

zh.t: 国会通过《铸币法案》，设立美国铸币局
zh.s: 美国铸币局是财政部下属机构，负责生产供美国贸易和商业使用的硬币，并管理金银的流通。美国铸币局是美国两家制造实体货币的机构之一；另一家是负责印制纸币的雕版印刷局。

en.t: The Coinage Act of 1792 (also known as the Mint Act; officially: An act establishing a mint, and regulating the Coins of the United States), passed by the United States Congress on April 2, 1792, created the United States dollar
en.s: The Coinage Act of 1792 (also known as the Mint Act; officially: An act establishing a mint, and regulating the Coins of the United States), passed by the United States Congress on April 2, 1792, created the United States dollar. It established its base unit as the dollar, along with the subunits cent (1⁄100 of dollar), dime (disme) (1⁄10), and mill (1⁄1000).

zh.s: 《1792年铸币法》又称《造币厂法》，正式名称为《设立造币厂并规范美国铸币的法案》。美国国会于1792年4月2日通过该法，创设了美元，并规定美元为基本单位，以及美分（美元的1/100）、角（又称dime，美元的1/10）和毫（美元的1/1000）等辅币单位。

en.s: The 1798 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 2. Incumbent Governor Increase Sumner was elected to a second term in office over Attorney General James Sullivan against minimal opposition.

en.t: Ludwig van Beethoven leads the premiere of his First Symphony in Vienna
en.s: Ludwig van Beethoven (baptised 17 December 1770 – 26 March 1827) was a German composer, conductor, and pianist. Regarded as one of the greatest composers in the history of Western music, he was mentored during the Classical period, and his musical style was a key driver of the transition to Romantic music, and the expansion of instrumental forms such as the symphony, the piano sonata and the string quartet.

zh.t: 贝多芬第一交响曲首演
zh.s: 1800年4月2日，贝多芬在维也纳安排并主持音乐会，首演自己的《第一交响曲》。

en.s: In the Battle of Copenhagen, also known as the First Battle of Copenhagen to distinguish it from the Second Battle of Copenhagen in 1807, a British naval fleet defeated a smaller force of the Royal Dano-Norwegian Navy anchored near Copenhagen on 2 April 1801. The battle came about over British fears that the powerful Danish fleet would ally with France, and a breakdown in diplomatic communications on both sides.

zh.s: 1801年4月2日，英国舰队在哥本哈根附近击败停泊于此、规模较小的丹麦—挪威皇家海军舰队。为与1807年的第二次哥本哈根海战区分，此役也称第一次哥本哈根海战。英国担心强大的丹麦舰队与法国结盟，加上双方外交沟通破裂，最终导致交战。

en.s: The 1806 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1806, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Federalist nominee Richard Jackson Jr. won a plurality of the vote against incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Henry Smith and Democratic-Republican candidate and incumbent chief justice of the Rhode Island Supreme Court Peleg Arnold.

zh.s: 1806年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人小理查德·杰克逊得票最多，领先民主共和党现任州长亨利·史密斯，以及同属民主共和党的州最高法院现任首席大法官佩莱格·阿诺德。

en.s: The 1810 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1810. Incumbent Federalist Governor Christopher Gore was defeated by Democratic-Republican nominee Elbridge Gerry. Republicans cast Gore as an ostentatious British-loving Tory who wanted to restore the monarchy (his parents were Loyalists during the Revolution), and Gerry as a patriotic American, while Federalists described Gerry as a "French partizan" and Gore as an honest man devoted to ridding the government of foreign influence.

zh.s: 1810年4月2日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人埃尔布里奇·格里击败联邦党现任州长克里斯托弗·戈尔。民主共和党人将戈尔描绘为浮夸、亲英、企图恢复君主制的托利党人，并提及其父母在革命期间效忠英国；他们则称格里是爱国的美国人。联邦党人反过来指格里是“法国拥护者”，赞扬戈尔诚实，致力于消除外国对政府的影响。

en.s: In the Battle of Lüneburg on 2 April 1813, Allied Russians and Prussians were victorious over a French and Saxon division. The battle was the first major combat action after the retreat of the defeated French in Russia behind the Elbe. Its importance lay in the moral effect on the German public as the first success of the Allies in the wars of liberation that were now beginning.

zh.s: 吕讷堡之战发生于1813年4月2日，俄国和普鲁士联军击败了法国与萨克森联军的一支师。法国军队在俄国战败撤退至易北河以西后，这是第一场大规模战斗。此战的意义在于其鼓舞作用：这是刚刚开始的解放战争中盟军首次获胜，对德国公众产生了振奋人心的影响。

en.t: Battle of Las Queseras del Medio
en.s: The Battle of Las Queseras del Medio was an important battle of the Venezuelan War of Independence. It took place on April 2, 1819. The forces of José Antonio Páez consisted of 153 lancers, who were llaneros. They were pitted against more than 1,000 Spanish cavalry. The battle is noted for a phrase of Páez’s that became famous: ¡Vuelvan Caras! (“About face!”) –although some sources state that he actually said ¡Vuelvan, Carajo! (“Return [to the battle], damn it!”).). It was April 1819 when Bolívar upon reaching the Arauca River, a tributary of the Orinoco south of the Apure plains, met cavalry division of General Páez encamped on the southern bank of the mighty river, some 300 miles south of Caracas.

zh.t: 拉斯克塞拉斯德尔梅迪奥战役
zh.s: 1819年4月2日，委内瑞拉独立战争中的拉斯克塞拉斯德尔梅迪奥战役爆发。何塞·安东尼奥·派斯率领153名来自平原地区的枪骑兵，对阵1000多名西班牙骑兵。派斯在战斗中喊出的“向后转！”后来广为流传，但部分资料认为他实际喊的是“回去打，见鬼！”。1819年4月，玻利瓦尔抵达阿普雷平原以南、奥里诺科河支流阿劳卡河时，在河流南岸遇到了派斯将军扎营的骑兵师，地点位于加拉加斯以南约300英里。

en.s: The 1821 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1821. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Brooks won re-election to a sixth term, defeating Democratic-Republican nominee William Eustis.

en.s: The 1838 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1838. Former congressman and Whig nominee William W. Ellsworth was elected, defeating former speaker of the Connecticut House of Representatives and Democratic nominee Seth Preston Beers with 54.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1838年4月2日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人、前国会议员威廉·W.埃尔斯沃思以54.14%的得票率，击败民主党候选人、前州众议院议长塞思·普雷斯顿·比尔斯。

en.s: The 1845 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1845, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. The Liberation nominee and former speaker of the Rhode Island House of Representatives Charles Jackson defeated the Law and Order incumbent governor James Fenner.

zh.s: 1845年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。解放派候选人、前州众议院议长查尔斯·杰克逊，击败法律与秩序党现任州长詹姆斯·芬纳。

en.s: The Battle of Hatvan was the first battle in the Spring Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence from 1848–1849, fought on 2 April 1849 between the Habsburg Empire and the Hungarian Revolutionary Army. This battle was the start of the Hungarian offensive, which had the purpose to liberate the Central and Western parts, and the capital of Hungary, occupied by imperial forces. The Austrian force were led by General Franz Schlik, while the Hungarians were led by Colonel András Gáspár, and lieutenant-colonel Ernő Poeltenberg. In the Hungarian army fought also the Polish Legion under the lead of Colonel Józef Wysocki.

zh.s: 1849年4月2日，哈布斯堡帝国军与匈牙利革命军交战，打响1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争春季战役的第一仗。此役开启了匈牙利军的进攻，目标是解放被帝国军占领的匈牙利中西部及首都。奥军由弗朗茨·施利克将军指挥，匈牙利军则由安德拉什·加什帕尔上校和厄尔诺·珀尔滕贝格中校率领。约瑟夫·维索茨基上校指挥的波兰军团也在匈牙利一方参战。

en.s: The 1849 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1849. Former congressman and Whig nominee Joseph Trumbull defeated former congressman and Democratic nominee Thomas H. Seymour as well as former Senator and Free Soil nominee John M. Niles with 49.35% of the vote. Niles had previously been the Democratic nominee for this same office in 1840. Trumbull won a plurality of the vote, but fell short of a majority.

zh.s: 1849年4月2日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人、前国会议员约瑟夫·特朗布尔，以49.35%的得票率击败民主党候选人、前国会议员托马斯·H.西摩，以及自由土地党候选人、前参议员约翰·M.奈尔斯。奈尔斯曾在1840年以民主党候选人身份竞选州长。特朗布尔此次得票最多，但未超过半数。

en.s: The 1851 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1851, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Democratic nominee and former member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives Philip Allen defeated Whig nominee Josiah Chapin and Free Soil nominee Edward Harris.

zh.s: 1851年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前州众议员菲利普·艾伦，击败辉格党候选人乔赛亚·查平和自由土地党候选人爱德华·哈里斯。

en.s: The 1855 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1855. Former state legislator and American Party nominee William T. Minor defeated former congressman and Democratic nominee Samuel Ingham and incumbent governor and Whig nominee Henry Dutton with 43.51% of the vote. The results reflected the national transition from the Second Party System to the Third Party System.

zh.s: 1855年4月2日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。美国人党候选人、前州议员威廉·T.迈纳以43.51%的得票率，击败民主党候选人、前国会议员塞缪尔·英厄姆，以及辉格党现任州长亨利·达顿。结果反映了全国政治从第二政党体系向第三政党体系过渡的趋势。

en.s: The 1856 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1856, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Republican governor William W. Hoppin won re-election over Democratic nominee Americus V. Potter in a rematch from the 1855 Rhode Island gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1856年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长威廉·W.霍平，再次对阵1855年的对手、民主党候选人阿梅里克斯·V.波特，并成功连任。

en.s: The 1860 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1860. Incumbent governor and Republican nominee William Alfred Buckingham defeated former governor and Democratic nominee Thomas H. Seymour with 50.30% of the vote.

zh.s: 1860年4月2日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长威廉·阿尔弗雷德·白金汉以50.30%的得票率，击败民主党候选人、前州长托马斯·H.西摩。

en.t: 1861 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1861 United States Senate election in California was held on April 2, 1861, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. The legislature had previously attempted to elect a senator from March 9–20, culminating with McDougall's apparent victory on the 22nd ballot; however, it was subsequently found that McDougall had not received the requisite majority, and his election was rescinded.

zh.t: 1861年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1861年4月2日，加利福尼亚州议会投票，选出代表该州的第三组联邦参议员。州议会此前曾在3月9日至20日尝试选出参议员，麦克杜格尔在第22轮投票后看似获胜，但随后发现其未取得规定的多数票，因此当选结果被撤销。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Rhode Island on April 2, 1862. The incumbent Constitutional Union governor William Sprague IV was re-elected without opposition. Sprague won the 1860 election leading a coalition of Conservative Republicans, former Whigs, and Democrats that formed to oppose the Radical Republican gubernatorial candidate, Seth Padelford. Following the election, his supporters coalesced in the Constitutional Union Party.

zh.s: 1862年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。宪政联盟党现任州长威廉·斯普拉格四世在没有竞争对手的情况下连任。斯普拉格曾在1860年领导一个由保守派共和党人、前辉格党人和民主党人组成的联盟，反对激进共和党州长候选人塞思·帕德尔福德，并赢得选举。此后他的支持者合组宪政联盟党。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Rhode Island on April 2, 1863. The Republican former mayor of Providence James Y. Smith defeated the Democratic incumbent governor William C. Cozzens. William Sprague IV won the 1860 Rhode Island gubernatorial election leading a coalition of Conservative Republicans, former Whigs, and Democrats. Following the election, Sprague's supporters coalesced in the Constitutional Union Party.

zh.s: 1863年4月2日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党候选人、前普罗维登斯市长詹姆斯·Y.史密斯，击败民主党现任州长威廉·C.科曾斯。此前，威廉·斯普拉格四世曾于1860年领导由保守派共和党人、前辉格党人和民主党人组成的联盟，赢得州长选举；其支持者此后合组宪政联盟党。

en.s: Steele's Greenville expedition took place from April 2 to 25, 1863, during the Vicksburg campaign of the American Civil War. Union forces commanded by Major General Frederick Steele occupied Greenville, Mississippi, and operated in the surrounding area, to divert Confederate attention from a more important movement made in Louisiana by Major General John A. McClernand's corps. Minor skirmishing between the two sides occurred, particularly in the early stages of the expedition.

zh.t: 斯蒂尔的格林维尔远征
zh.s: 斯蒂尔的格林维尔远征于1863年4月2日至25日进行，是美国内战维克斯堡战役的一部分。弗雷德里克·斯蒂尔少将指挥的联邦军占领密西西比州格林维尔，并在周边地区行动，以转移邦联军对路易斯安那州另一项更重要行动的注意力；那项行动由约翰·A·麦克勒南德少将的军团执行。远征初期双方发生过一些小规模交火。

en.s: The Skirmish at Terre Noire Creek, also known as the Skirmish at Wolf Creek or Skirmish at Antoine, an engagement during the Camden Expedition of the American Civil War, was fought on April 2, 1864. The action occurred about 1 mile (1.6 km) east of Terre Noire Creek along a defile near the towns of Hollywood, Arkansas (sometimes known as Spoonville or Witherspoonville) and Antoine, Arkansas.

zh.t: 泰尔努瓦尔溪小规模战斗
zh.s: 泰尔努瓦尔溪小规模战斗又称沃尔夫溪小规模战斗或安托万小规模战斗，是美国内战卡姆登远征期间发生的一场交战，于1864年4月2日爆发。战斗地点在阿肯色州泰尔努瓦尔溪以东约1英里（1.6公里）处，位于好莱坞镇（有时称斯普恩维尔或威瑟斯庞维尔）和安托万镇附近的一处狭长通道。

en.s: The Battle of Selma was a military engagement near the end of the American Civil War. It was fought in Selma, Alabama, on April 2, 1865, a town of about ten thousand inhabitants. Union Army forces under Major General James H. Wilson defeated a Confederate Army force under Lieutenant General Nathan Bedford Forrest. On March 22, 1865, Wilson led three divisions of Union cavalry, totaling 13,500 men, on a raid from Gravelly Springs, deep into largely untouched southern Alabama. He was opposed by Confederate General Forrest, whose soldiers numbered 2,000, and many of these were old men and boys.

zh.s: 1865年4月2日，美国南北战争接近结束时，双方在阿拉巴马州约有一万居民的塞尔玛交战。詹姆斯·H.威尔逊少将率联邦军，击败内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特中将指挥的邦联军。3月22日，威尔逊率三个骑兵师、共13500人，从格拉夫利斯普林斯出发，深入此前基本未受战火波及的阿拉巴马州南部。阻挡他的福雷斯特仅有2000名士兵，其中许多为老人和少年。

en.s: The Battle of Sutherland's Station was an American Civil War conflict fought on April 2, 1865, in Dinwiddie, Virginia during the Appomattox Campaign. Union columns converged on Petersburg on April 2, pushing through a large section of the Confederate defensive entrenchments. As Robert E. Lee desperately sought to buy time to allow his army to withdraw, Ulysses S. Grant launched several other attacks. Stubborn Confederate resistance at Fort Gregg delayed Grant's progress. Meanwhile, Maj. Gen. Nelson A. Miles's Union division battered Henry Heth's Confederates near Sutherland's Station and drove them off the field. The Confederate defenders were scattered and driven northwestward.

zh.s: 1865年4月2日，美国南北战争的阿波马托克斯战役期间，双方在弗吉尼亚州丁威迪的萨瑟兰车站交战。当天联邦军多路向彼得斯堡集结，突破邦联军一大片防御壕沟。罗伯特·E.李极力争取撤军时间，尤利西斯·S.格兰特则连续发动其他攻势。邦联军在格雷格堡的顽强抵抗拖慢了联邦军推进。与此同时，纳尔逊·A.迈尔斯少将的师在萨瑟兰车站附近重创亨利·赫思的邦联军，将守军赶出战场。守军被打散，向西北方向退却。

The Union Army (Army of the Potomac, Army of the Shenandoah and Army of the James) under the overall command of General-in-chief, Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant, launched an assault on General Robert E.

zh.s: 第三次彼得斯堡战役又称彼得斯堡突破战或彼得斯堡陷落，发生于1865年4月2日，地点在弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡以南及西南。当时美国南北战争即将结束，历时292天的里士满—彼得斯堡战役（又称彼得斯堡围城战）进入尾声，阿波马托克斯战役刚刚开始。联邦军总司令尤利西斯·S.格兰特中将，统率波托马克、谢南多厄和詹姆斯三个军团发动进攻。原文在写到对手将军的姓名“Robert E.”时中断。

en.s: The 1866 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 2, 1866. Civil War general and Republican nominee Joseph Roswell Hawley defeated Democratic nominee James E. English with 50.30% of the vote. As this was the first election held after the American Civil War, some aspects of the National Union Party were still present.

zh.s: 1866年4月2日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。共和党候选人、南北战争将领约瑟夫·罗斯韦尔·霍利，以50.30%的得票率击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·E.英格利希。这是南北战争结束后的首次州长选举，全国联盟党的一些组织和政治影响仍然存在。

en.s: The Battle of 2 de Abril was fought on April 2, 1867, in and around the city of Puebla, Puebla. It was one of the major military actions in the Franco-Mexican War between elements of the Mexican Army of the Republic commanded by General Porfirio Díaz and troops at the service of the Mexican Empire composed by Mexican imperialist soldiers. The campaign of Puebla includes the siege of Puebla, the battle of April 2 and the capture of the forts of Loreto and Guadalupe. The battle, also known as the Third Battle of Puebla, was the end of a siege on the city of Puebla, which started on March 9 of the same year.

zh.s: 1867年4月2日，普埃布拉州普埃布拉市及周边爆发“四月二日战役”，又称第三次普埃布拉战役。这是法墨战争中的主要军事行动之一，由波菲里奥·迪亚斯将军指挥的墨西哥共和军，对阵效忠墨西哥帝国的墨西哥帝制派军队。普埃布拉战役包括围城、4月2日的战斗，以及夺取洛雷托堡和瓜达卢佩堡。此役结束了从同年3月9日开始的普埃布拉围城。

en.t: Canadian Cree warriors attack the village of Frog Lake, killing nine
en.s: Frog Lake is a Cree community of Frog Lake First Nation approximately 207 km (129 mi) east of Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. It is located 11 km (6.8 mi) northeast of the hamlet of Heinsburg and 13 km (8.1 mi) southwest of the Fishing Lake Metis Settlement. Frog Lake has 2,454 band members as of August, 2007. Frog Lake has a reserve population of approximately 1,000 residing on-reserve.

en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1907, Republican Fred A. Busse defeated Democratic incumbent Edward F. Dunne. This was the first mayoral election to a four-year term in Chicago's history, as terms had been extended from two to four years. The election took place on April 2. In order to select their nominee, the Democratic Party held a primary election open to members at its municipal party convention.

zh.s: 1907年芝加哥市长选举中，共和党人弗雷德·A·布塞击败民主党籍现任市长爱德华·F·邓恩。这是芝加哥历史上首场市长任期为四年的选举，此前市长任期已从两年延长至四年。选举于4月2日举行。民主党在市级党提名大会上举行了仅对党员开放的初选，以选出本党候选人。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 2 April 1910. All 42 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal and Democratic Union (LDU) government led by Premier of South Australia Archibald Peake was defeated by the United Labor Party (ULP) led by John Verran. Each of the 13 districts elected multiple members, with voters casting multiple votes.

zh.s: 1910年4月2日，南澳大利亚州举行州选举，改选众议院全部42个席位。由州长阿奇博尔德·皮克领导的现任自由民主联盟政府败给约翰·弗伦领导的联合工党。13个选区均选出多名议员，选民可投多票。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Milwaukee was held on April 2, 1912. Incumbent mayor Emil Seidel was defeated for re-election by Democratic-Republican Fusion candidate Gerhard Adolph Bading, who won 58% of the vote. Bading was sworn in on April 17, 1912. Candidates included Milwaukee mayor Emil Seidel, former Milwaukee health commissioner Gerhard Adolph Bading, and Prohibitionist Ivan D. Mishoff.

zh.s: 1912年4月2日，密尔沃基举行市长选举。现任市长埃米尔·塞德尔败给民主共和融合派候选人格哈德·阿道夫·巴丁，巴丁获得58%的选票，并于1912年4月17日宣誓就职。候选人还包括塞德尔、前密尔沃基卫生专员巴丁和禁酒党人伊万·D·米肖夫。

en.s: The Second Battle of Torreón, which lasted from March 21 to April 2, 1914, was one of the major battles of the Mexican Revolution, where revolutionaries led by Pancho Villa occupied a city protected by Huertist federal forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: General elections were held in Argentina on 2 April 1916. Voters elected the President, legislators, and local officials. The first secret-ballot presidential elections in the nation's history, they were mandatory and had a turnout of 63%. The turnout for the Chamber of Deputies election was 65%. The election has been characterized as the first free and fair elections in Argentina.

zh.s: 阿根廷于1916年4月2日举行大选，选出总统、议员和地方官员。这是该国历史上首次以秘密投票选举总统，并实行强制投票，总统选举投票率为63%，众议院选举投票率为65%。这次选举被称为阿根廷首次自由、公平的选举。

en.t: American entry into World War I: President Wilson asks the U.S. Congress for a declaration of war on Germany
en.s: The United States entered World War I on April 6, 1917, more than two and a half years after the war began in Austria-Hungary. Apart from an Anglophile element urging early support for the British and an anti-tsarist element sympathizing with Germany's war against Russia, American public opinion had generally reflected a desire to stay out of the war.

zh.t: 威尔逊总统请求国会对德国宣战
zh.s: 1917年4月2日，威尔逊总统向美国国会请求对德国宣战。美国于4月6日正式参战；此前美国公众舆论总体上希望置身于战争之外。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate special election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate special election in Wisconsin was held on April 2, 1918. Incumbent Democrat Senator Paul O. Husting was killed in a hunting accident the previous year. Republican U.S. Representative Irvine Lenroot defeated Democratic Federal Trade Commission Chairman Joseph E. Davies and Socialist former Congressman Victor L. Berger. Primary elections were held on March 19.

zh.t: 1918年威斯康星州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1918年4月2日，美国威斯康星州举行联邦参议员特别选举。民主党参议员保罗·O.赫斯廷于前一年在狩猎事故中死亡。共和党联邦众议员欧文·伦鲁特，击败民主党候选人、联邦贸易委员会主席约瑟夫·E.戴维斯，以及社会党候选人、前国会议员维克托·L.伯格。初选于3月19日举行。

en.s: The 1918 Wisconsin Supreme Court special election was a special election held on Tuesday, April 2, 1918, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Incumbent justice Marvin B. Rosenberry (who had been appointed to in 1916 to fill a vacancy) won re-election over Charles H. Crownhart (the former chairman of the Wisconsin Industrial Commission). The election coincided with a special U.S.

zh.t: 1918年威斯康星州最高法院特别选举
zh.s: 1918年4月2日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官特别选举。1916年获任命填补空缺的现任法官马文·B.罗森伯里，击败州工业委员会前主席查尔斯·H.克朗哈特，成功连任。原文接着提到同日另有一场美国联邦特别选举，但句子在此处中断。

en.s: The First Transjordan attack on Amman (known to the British as the First Attack on Amman) and to their enemy as the First Battle of the Jordan took place between 21 March and 2 April 1918, as a consequence of the successful Battle of Tell 'Asur which occurred after the Capture of Jericho in February and the Occupation of the Jordan Valley began, during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I.

zh.s: 1918年3月21日至4月2日，第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役期间，英军发动第一次跨约旦河进攻安曼的行动。英方称之为“第一次安曼攻势”，对手称其为“第一次约旦河战役”。此前，英军于2月攻占杰里科，开始占领约旦河谷，随后又赢得泰勒阿苏尔战役，这次进攻便是在此基础上展开。

en.s: The March Days or March Events (Azerbaijani: Mart hadisələri) was a period of inter-ethnic strife and clashes which took place between 30 March – 2 April 1918 in the city of Baku and adjacent areas of the Baku Governorate of the Transcaucasian Commissariat.

en.s: The Battle of Bolshie Ozerki was a major engagement fought during the Allied North Russia Intervention in the Russian Civil War. Beginning on March 31, 1919, a force of British, American, Polish, and White Russian troops engaged several Red Army partisan regiments at the village of Bolshie Ozerki. Although the initial Allied attacks were repelled, the outnumbered Allies managed to repel the Soviet flanking attempts that followed and the Red Army was later ordered to withdraw.

zh.s: 大奥泽尔基之战是俄国内战期间盟军干涉俄国北部行动中的一场重要战斗。1919年3月31日，英国、美国、波兰和白俄军队在大奥泽尔基村与数支红军游击团交战。尽管盟军最初的进攻被击退，但兵力较少的盟军成功挫败了随后的苏军侧翼进攻，红军后来接到撤退命令。

en.s: General elections were held in Argentina on 2 April 1922. Marcelo Torcuato de Alvear of the Radical Civic Union (UCR) was elected president, while Elpidio González, also of the UCR, was elected vice-president. The UCR also maintained its majority in the Chamber of Deputies, winning 49 of the 85 seats available, leaving it holding 95 of the 158 seats in the Chamber.

zh.s: 阿根廷于1922年4月2日举行大选。激进公民联盟的马塞洛·托尔夸托·德·阿尔韦亚尔当选总统，同党的埃尔皮迪奥·冈萨雷斯当选副总统。该党也在改选的85个众议院议席中赢得49席，使其在158席的众议院中持有95席，维持多数。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 1 and 2 April 1924. Although the Social Democratic Party remained the largest in Parliament with 60 of the 200 seats, Lauri Ingman of the National Coalition Party formed a centre-right majority government in May 1924. It remained intact until the Agrarians left in November 1924. Voter turnout was 57.4%.

zh.s: 芬兰于1924年4月1日和2日举行议会选举。社会民主党虽以200席中的60席继续保持第一大党地位，但民族联合党的劳里·英格曼在5月组成了中右翼多数政府。该政府维持到11月，随后农业派退出。投票率为57.4%。

en.s: The 1929 Chicago aldermanic election was held on February 26, 1929, with a runoff on April 2, to elect the 50 members of the Chicago City Council. The elections were non-partisan. Held in the middle of mayor William Hale Thompson's term, it would be the penultimate midterm election; four-year terms for aldermen were adopted in 1935, coinciding with the mayoral election that year.

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 2 April 1938 to elect the 62 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The Labor government of Premier William Forgan Smith was seeking a third term in office. During the previous term, the Country and United Australia parties had emerged from the united Country and Progressive National Party, which had represented conservative forces for over a decade.

zh.s: 1938年4月2日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，选出州立法议会的62名议员。州长威廉·福根·史密斯领导的工党政府寻求连任第三届。在此前任期内，乡村党和澳大利亚联合党从代表保守派力量十余年的乡村进步国民党中分裂出来。

en.s: The Battle of Suursaari was fought over the frozen Gulf of Finland on and around the islands of Gogland (Finnish: Suursaari, Swedish: Hogland)) and Bolshoy Tyuters (Finnish: Suur-Tytärsaari, (Swedish: Tyterskär)) during the Second World War. After sharp fighting the numerically superior Finnish forces seized the Gogland and Bolshoy Tyuters against the Red Army, and later provided support for Nazi German forces defending Bolshoy Tyuters against Soviet counterattacks.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，苏尔萨里岛之战在结冰的芬兰湾及周边岛屿展开，战场包括戈格兰岛（芬兰语：Suursaari；瑞典语：Hogland）和大秋特尔岛（芬兰语：Suur-Tytärsaari；瑞典语：Tyterskär）。经过激烈交战，人数占优的芬兰军队从红军手中夺取两岛，后来又支援纳粹德国部队，协助其抵御苏军对大秋特尔岛的反攻。

en.s: Myanmar has been in armed conflict since 1948, when the country, then known as Burma, gained independence from the United Kingdom. The conflict has largely been ethnic-based, with ethnic armed organisations fighting Myanmar's armed forces, the Tatmadaw, for self-determination. Despite numerous ceasefires and the creation of autonomous self-administered zones in 2008, armed groups continue to call for independence, increased autonomy, democracy, or the federalisation of Myanmar.

en.t: 1957 United States Senate special election in Texas
en.s: The 1957 United States Senate special election in Texas was held on April 2, 1957, to complete the unexpired term of Senator Price Daniel, who resigned to become Governor of Texas. Interim Senator William Blakley did not run in the special election. Ralph Yarborough won the race with a plurality of the vote; no majority was required.

zh.t: 1957年得克萨斯州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1957年4月2日，美国得克萨斯州举行联邦参议员特别选举，选出接替普赖斯·丹尼尔完成剩余任期的议员。丹尼尔为就任州长而辞职，临时参议员威廉·布莱克利未参加特别选举。拉尔夫·亚伯勒得票最多而获胜，该次选举不要求票数过半。

en.s: The 1957 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 2, 1957. Incumbent Norris Poulson was re-elected with minimal opposition. Poulson initially stated that he would retire from the office before changing his mind and filing for re-election; Kenneth Hahn, John S. Gibson Jr., and Don Belding all withdrew after Poulson made his announcement. Four candidates still ran to defeat Poulson, but Poulson won outright in the primary election.

zh.s: 1957年4月2日，洛杉矶举行市长选举。现任市长诺里斯·鲍尔森在竞争不激烈的情况下连任。他最初表示打算退休，后来改变主意并登记参选；在他宣布参选后，肯尼斯·哈恩、约翰·S·吉布森二世和唐·贝尔丁均退出。仍有四名候选人试图击败鲍尔森，但他在初选中直接获胜。

en.s: Democrat William Proxmire won a special election to fill the vacancy created by the death of Senator Joseph R. McCarthy (R-WI). Also, Price Daniel (D-TX) left the Senate to become governor of Texas, and Democrat Ralph Yarborough won a special election for that Senate seat. The Democrats thus made a net gain of one seat.

zh.s: 民主党人威廉·普罗克斯迈尔在特别选举中胜出，填补参议员约瑟夫·R·麦卡锡（共和党，威斯康星州）去世后留下的席位。此外，德克萨斯州民主党人普赖斯·丹尼尔离开参议院出任州长，民主党人拉尔夫·亚伯勒在特别选举中赢得了他的席位。民主党因此净增一个席位。

en.s: The 1963 Dallas mayoral election was held on Tuesday April 2, 1963, with incumbent Earle Cabell being re-elected with 66.6 percent of the vote. During this term of Cabell's mayoralty, President John F. Kennedy would be assassinated in Dallas on November 22, 1963. Cabell resigned as mayor on February 3, 1964, in order to run for Congress. He would go on to win the election and unseat Republican incumbent Bruce Alger.

zh.s: 1963年4月2日星期二，美国达拉斯举行市长选举，现任市长厄尔·卡贝尔以66.6%的得票率连任。在这一任期内，总统约翰·F.肯尼迪于11月22日在达拉斯遇刺。卡贝尔于1964年2月3日辞去市长职务，转而竞选国会议员，后来击败共和党现任议员布鲁斯·阿尔杰，当选进入国会。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1963 was held on April 2, 1963. The election saw Richard J. Daley elected to a third term as mayor, defeating Republican Ben Adamowski by a double-digit margin. The party was preceded by primary elections held on February 26, 1963 to determine the nominees of both the Democratic Party and the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1963年4月2日，芝加哥举行市长选举。理查德·J.戴利以两位数百分点的优势击败共和党人本·亚当诺夫斯基，赢得第三个任期。民主党与共和党此前已于2月26日举行初选，分别确定候选人。

en.s: The 1963 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on Tuesday, April 2, 1963 to elect a justice to a full ten-year seat the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Bruce F. Beilfuss won an open race to succeed retiring justice Timothy Brown.

zh.t: 1963年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1963年4月2日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官蒂莫西·布朗退休，布鲁斯·F.拜尔富斯在无人寻求连任的竞争中获胜，接任其席位。

en.s: Operation Popeye was the advance of the Tiradentes and Caicó detachments of the Brazilian Army and the Military Police of Minas Gerais (PMMG), from Minas Gerais, to Rio de Janeiro and Brasília during the 1964 Brazilian coup d'état. Their rearguard was protected within Minas Gerais by operations Cage and Silence. Ordered by general Olímpio Mourão Filho, from the 4th Military Region/Infantry Division, it was the coup's first military offensive.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 波派行动是1964年巴西政变期间的一次军事推进行动。巴西陆军的蒂拉登特斯和卡伊科分队从米纳斯吉拉斯州向里约热内卢和巴西利亚推进，后方则由该州的“牢笼行动”和“沉默行动”保护。行动由第四军区/步兵师的奥林皮奥·莫朗·菲略将军下令，是政变期间的首次军事攻势。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Kooyong on 2 April 1966, following the resignation of Liberal Party MP and former Prime Minister Sir Robert Menzies on 16 February 1966. The by-election was won by Liberal candidate Andrew Peacock, although with a reduced majority.

zh.s: 1966年4月2日，澳大利亚众议院库扬选区举行补选。自由党议员、前总理罗伯特·孟席斯爵士于2月16日辞职，留下空缺。自由党候选人安德鲁·皮科克获胜，但领先优势较前缩小。

en.s: The 1968 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on Tuesday, April 2, 1968 to elect a justice to a full ten-year seat the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Incumbent justice Leo B. Hanley (appointed to fill a vacancy) was relected to a ten-year term, unopposed.

zh.t: 1968年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1968年4月2日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。此前获任命填补空缺的利奥·B.汉利，在没有竞争对手的情况下当选，取得完整的十年任期。

en.s: LOT Polish Airlines Flight 165 was an Antonov An-24 aircraft, registration SP-LTF, operating a scheduled passenger flight from Warsaw to Krakow Balice airport. It crashed into a mountain on 2 April 1969 at 16:08 local time (UTC+1) during a snowstorm. All 53 people on board were killed.

zh.t: 波兰航空165号班机空难（1969年）
zh.s: 波兰航空165号班机由一架注册号SP-LTF的安东诺夫安-24飞机执飞，执行从华沙到克拉科夫巴利采机场的定期客运航班。1969年4月2日当地时间16时08分（UTC+1），飞机在暴风雪中撞山，机上53人全部遇难。

en.s: The 1974 Nova Scotia general election was held on 2 April 1974 to elect members of the 51st House of Assembly of the Province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Liberal Party. Most of its MLAs were elected in single-member district using first past the post voting but some, such as in Colchester and Yarmouth, were elected in two-seat districts using plurality block voting.

zh.s: 1974年4月2日，加拿大新斯科舍省举行大选，选出第51届省议会的议员。自由党获胜。大多数议员在单议席选区通过简单多数制选出，但科尔切斯特和亚茅斯等部分选区为双议席选区，采用多议席相对多数制。

en.s: The Hue–Da Nang Campaign was a series of military actions conducted by the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) against the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) during the Vietnam War, also known in Vietnam as the American War. The campaign was centred on the cities of Huế (Thừa Thiên-Huế Province) and Da Nang (Quảng Nam Province), with secondary fronts in the provinces of Quảng Trị and Quảng Ngãi.

zh.s: 顺化—岘港战役是越南战争期间越南人民军针对越南共和国军开展的一系列军事行动。在越南，这场战争也称为“美国战争”。战役主要围绕顺化（承天顺化省）和岘港（广南省）两座城市展开，广治省和广义省也有次要战线。

en.t: Prince Norodom Sihanouk resigns as leader of Cambodia and is placed under house arrest
en.s: Norodom Sihanouk (; 31 October 1922 – 15 October 2012) was King, Chief of State and Prime Minister of Cambodia. He is known as Samdech Euv (meaning "King Father") or by his nickname The Pink Prince. During his lifetime, Cambodia was under various regimes, from French colonial rule (until 1953), a Japanese puppet state (1945), an independent kingdom (1953–1970), a military republic (1970–1975), the Khmer Rouge regime (1975–1979), a Vietnamese-backed communist regime (1979–1989), a transitional communist regime (1989–1993) to eventually another kingdom (since 1993).

zh.t: 诺罗敦·西哈努克亲王辞去柬埔寨领导人职务并被软禁
zh.s: 1970年3月23日，刚被罢免的柬埔寨国家元首诺罗敦·西哈努克宣布成立民族统一阵线，号召民众反对朗诺的新政府。他曾担任柬埔寨国王、国家元首和首相，被称为“国父”或“粉红王子”；其一生历经法国殖民统治、日本扶植的傀儡政权、独立王国、军事共和国、红色高棉时期、越南支持的共产党政权及王制恢复等阶段。

en.s: General elections were held in Fiji between 19 March and 2 April 1977. As a result of a split in the ethnic Fijian vote, the ruling Alliance Party of Prime Minister Kamisese Mara suffered a narrow defeat. Although the Alliance Party received the most votes, it won only 24 seats, two fewer than the Indo-Fijian-dominated National Federation Party (NFP).

zh.s: 斐济于1977年3月19日至4月2日举行大选。由于斐济原住民选票分裂，首相卡米塞塞·马拉领导的执政联盟党以微弱差距落败。联盟党虽然得票最多，却只取得24席，比印度裔斐济人主导的民族联盟党少两席。

en.s: 1978 Japanese Super Cup was the Japanese Super Cup competition. The match was played at Osaka Nagai Stadium in Osaka on April 2, 1978. Fujita Industries won the championship.

zh.s: 1978年日本超级杯于1978年4月2日在大阪市的大阪长居体育场举行。藤田工业队赢得冠军。

loc: 福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）

en.s: The Falklands War (Spanish: Guerra de las Malvinas), also known as the Falklands Conflict, Falklands Crisis, and the Guerra del Atlántico Sur (Spanish for "South Atlantic War"), was a ten-week war between Argentina and the United Kingdom over two British overseas territories in the South Atlantic: the Falkland Islands and South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands. It began on Friday, 2 April 1982, when Argentina invaded and occupied the Falkland Islands (and, the following day, South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands) in an attempt to establish the sovereignty it had claimed over them.

zh.s: 马尔维纳斯群岛战争又称福克兰战争、福克兰冲突、福克兰危机或南大西洋战争，是阿根廷与英国为争夺南大西洋两处英国海外领地——福克兰群岛及南乔治亚和南桑威奇群岛——而进行的十周战争。1982年4月2日星期五，阿根廷军队入侵并占领福克兰群岛，次日又占领南乔治亚和南桑威奇群岛，试图落实其对这些岛屿的主权主张，战争由此爆发。

en.s: Argentine forces invaded the Falkland Islands on 2 April 1982 in a military operation code-named Operation Rosario (Operación Rosario). The invasion served as a catalyst for the subsequent Falklands War. The Argentines mounted amphibious landings and the invasion ended with the surrender of Falkland Government House, due to the location of the fighting the invasion is occasionally known as the Battle of Government House.

zh.s: 1982年4月2日，阿根廷军队代号“罗萨里奥行动”入侵福克兰群岛。入侵成为随后福克兰战争的导火线。阿根廷军队实施两栖登陆，最终迫使福克兰群岛政府大楼守军投降。由于战斗地点，这次入侵有时也称“政府大楼之战”。

en.s: The 1983 German Supercup was an unofficial edition of the German Supercup, a football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. The match was played at the Olympiastadion in Munich, and contested by cup winners Bayern Munich and league champions Hamburger SV. Bayern won the match 4–2 on penalties, following a 1–1 draw (with no extra time played), to claim the unofficial title.

zh.s: 1983年的德国超级杯是一场非官方比赛，参赛双方是上赛季德甲冠军汉堡队和德国杯冠军拜仁慕尼黑队。比赛在慕尼黑奥林匹克体育场举行，双方在常规时间内1比1战平，未进行加时赛；拜仁在点球大战中以4比2获胜，夺得这项非官方赛事的冠军。

en.s: The 1985 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 2, 1985, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Nathan Heffernan (who had held the seat since 1964) was re-elected.

zh.t: 1985年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1985年4月2日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。自1964年起担任该职的内森·赫弗南成功连任。

en.s: The 1985 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 2, 1985 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the re-election of Vincent C. Schoemehl to a second term. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 5.

zh.s: 1985年4月2日，密苏里州圣路易斯举行市长选举。文森特·C·舍梅尔连任，开始第二个任期。选举前，政党初选已于3月5日举行。

en.s: The 1985 Newfoundland general election was held on 2 April 1985 to elect members of the 40th General Assembly of Newfoundland. It was won by the Progressive Conservative party under Premier Brian Peckford.

zh.s: 1985年4月2日，纽芬兰举行大选，选出第40届纽芬兰议会的议员。布赖恩·佩克福德领导的进步保守党获胜。

en.s: WrestleMania V was a 1989 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the fifth annual WrestleMania and took place on April 2, 1989, at the Atlantic City Convention Hall (promoted as Trump Plaza) in Atlantic City, New Jersey for a second consecutive year. WrestleMania V went head-to-head against Clash of the Champions VI, a television special by rival company World Championship Wrestling.

zh.s: 第五届摔角狂热是世界摔角联盟（WWF，后来的WWE）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1989年4月2日在美国新泽西州大西洋城会议厅举行。这是连续第二年在此举办，场地在宣传中称为特朗普广场。赛事与竞争对手世界冠军摔角（WCW）的电视特别节目《冠军冲突第六届》同时播出，正面对决。

en.s: The 1989 Haitian coup d'état attempt was a bloodless military coup attempt that took place in Haiti on 1–2 April 1989, when a group of rebel army officers attempted to overthrow the military government of Lt. Gen. Prosper Avril. The coup attempt, which included gunfire near the National Palace, was reportedly staged by Col. Himmler Rebu, commander of the elite Leopards battalion (stationed in Pétion-Ville, close to the capital Port-au-Prince).

zh.s: 1989年4月1日至2日，海地发生一次不流血的军事政变未遂。一群叛变军官试图推翻普罗斯珀·阿夫里尔中将领导的军政府。政变未遂期间，国家宫附近据报发生枪击。行动据称由希姆勒·雷布上校策划，他当时指挥驻扎在首都太子港附近佩蒂翁维尔的精锐“豹”营。

en.s: The Bijeljina massacre involved the killing of civilians by Serb paramilitary groups in Bijeljina on 1–2 April 1992 in the run-up to the Bosnian War. The majority of those killed were Bosnian Muslims. Members of other ethnicities were also killed, as well as Serbs deemed disloyal by the local authorities.

en.s: WrestleMania XI was the eleventh annual WrestleMania pay-per-view event held by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) at the Hartford Civic Center in Hartford, Connecticut on April 2, 1995. The main event was a match between NFL linebacker Lawrence Taylor, who faced Bam Bam Bigelow as the result of an argument that took place between the two at the 1995 Royal Rumble. Taylor won the match, which led to Bigelow being kicked out of Ted DiBiase's Million Dollar Corporation. Shawn Michaels faced WWF World Heavyweight Champion Diesel in a title match but was unable to win the championship.

zh.s: 第十一届摔角狂热是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办的年度按次付费赛事，于1995年4月2日在美国康涅狄格州哈特福德市民中心举行。压轴赛由NFL线卫劳伦斯·泰勒对阵班班·比格洛，起因是两人在1995年皇家大战赛事中发生争执。泰勒获胜，比格洛随后在剧情中被逐出泰德·迪比亚西的“百万美元公司”团体。肖恩·迈克尔斯也挑战了WWF世界重量级冠军迪塞尔，但未能夺冠。

en.t: Weekly Pro Wrestling Tokyo Dome Show
en.s: The Weekly Pro Wrestling Tokyo Dome Show, often referred to as Bridge of Dreams (Japanese: 夢の架け橋～憧夢春爛漫～, Hepburn: Yume no Kakehashi: Dōmu Haruranman), was a multi-promotional professional wrestling and mixed martial arts television special event hosted by Japanese wrestling magazine, Weekly Pro Wrestling. The event took place on April 2, 1995 at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.t: 《周刊职业摔角》东京巨蛋大赛
zh.s: 1995年4月2日，日本摔角杂志《周刊职业摔角》在东京巨蛋举办多联盟联合的职业摔角与综合格斗电视特别赛事，通常称为“梦想之桥：憧梦春烂漫”。

en.s: The 1995 Football League Cup final was a football match played between Bolton Wanderers and Liverpool on 2 April 1995 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 1994–95 Football League Cup, the 35th staging of the Football League Cup, a football competition for the 92 teams in the Premier League and The Football League. This was Bolton's first-ever final appearance.

zh.s: 1995年4月2日，博尔顿流浪者与利物浦在伦敦温布利球场争夺1994—1995赛季英格兰联赛杯冠军。这是第35届联赛杯，由英超及英格兰足球联赛共92支球队参加，也是博尔顿首次进入该赛事决赛。

en.s: A Dáil by-election was held in the constituency of Dublin West in Ireland on Tuesday, 2 April 1996, to fill a vacancy in the 27th Dáil. It followed the death of Fianna Fáil Teachta Dála (TD) Brian Lenihan Snr on 1 November 1995. The writ of election to fill the vacancy was agreed by the Dáil on 12 March 1996.

zh.s: 1996年4月2日星期二，爱尔兰众议院都柏林西选区举行补选，填补第27届众议院的一个空缺。共和党议员老布赖恩·莱尼汉于1995年11月1日去世，造成空缺。众议院于1996年3月12日同意发出补选令。

en.s: A Dáil by-election was held in the constituency of Donegal North-East in Ireland on Tuesday, 2 April 1996, to fill a vacancy in the 27th Dáil. It followed the death of Independent Fianna Fáil Teachta Dála (TD) Neil Blaney on 8 November 1995. The writ of election to fill the vacancy was agreed by the Dáil on 12 March 1996.

zh.s: 1996年4月2日星期二，爱尔兰众议院多尼戈尔东北选区举行补选，填补第27届众议院的一个空缺。独立共和党议员尼尔·布莱尼于1995年11月8日去世，造成空缺。众议院于1996年3月12日同意发出补选令。

en.t: Hong Kong Election Committee Subsector elections, 1998
en.s: The 1998 Election Committee Subsector Elections were held on 2 April 1998 to form the Election Committee responsible for electing the Chief Executive of Hong Kong as well as 10 seats of the Election Committee constituency in the first Legislative Council election in May 1998. The 800-member Election Committee was formed, consisting of 77 ex-officio members; 40 members nominated by the Religious Subsector; 95 returned uncontested from four subsectors; and 588 returned from 31 subsectors after the subsector elections.

zh.t: 1998年香港选举委员会界别分组选举
zh.s: 1998年4月2日，香港举行选举委员会界别分组选举，组成负责选出行政长官，以及在同年5月首届立法会选举中选出十名选委会议员的选举委员会。800名委员包括77名当然委员、40名宗教界提名委员、四个界别分组中无竞争自动当选的95名委员，以及31个界别分组选举产生的588名委员。

en.s: The Torneo Gran Alternativa (April 1999) (Spanish for "Great Alternative Tournament") was a professional wrestling tournament held by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; Spanish for "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament was held on April 2, 1999, in Mexico City, Mexico at CMLL's main venue, Arena México. The Gran Alternativa tournament features tag teams composed of a rookie, or novato, and a veteran wrestler for an elimination tournament.

zh.t: 重大机遇摔角锦标赛（1999年4月）
zh.s: 1999年4月“重大机遇”是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的职业摔角锦标赛，于4月2日在该联盟的主要场馆、墨西哥城墨西哥竞技场举行。赛事采用双打淘汰制，每队由一名新人与一名资深摔角手搭档。

en.s: WrestleMania 2000 (sequentially known as WrestleMania 16) was the sixteenth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on April 2, 2000, at the Arrowhead Pond of Amaheim in Anaheim, California. The main event was a four-way elimination match for the WWF Championship involving reigning champion Triple H, The Rock, Mick Foley, and The Big Show, which Triple H won after last eliminating The Rock. Main matches on the undercard included a triangle ladder match for the WWF Tag Team Championship involving Edge and Christian, The Hardy Boyz, and The Dudley Boyz, and a two-fall triple threat match for the WWF Intercontinental and European Championships involving Kurt Angle, Chris Jericho, and Chris Benoit.

zh.s: 摔角狂热2000按届数为第十六届，是世界摔角联盟（WWF）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2000年4月2日在美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆箭头池体育馆举行。压轴赛是WWF冠军四方淘汰赛，现任冠军Triple H对阵巨石强森、米克·弗利和大秀哥；Triple H最后淘汰巨石强森获胜。其他主要比赛包括艾吉与克里斯蒂安、哈迪兄弟和达德利兄弟三队争夺WWF双打冠军的三方梯子赛，以及科特·安格、克里斯·杰里科和克里斯·班瓦争夺洲际及欧洲冠军的两次决胜三方赛。

en.s: The 2000 Puerto Rico Democratic presidential caucuses were held on April 2, 2000, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. 58 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated to presidential candidates. Although Puerto Rico would not participate in the 2000 presidential general election because it is a U.S. territory and not a state, it equally participated in the U.S. presidential caucuses and primaries.

zh.t: 2000年波多黎各民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2000年4月2日，波多黎各举行民主党总统党团会议，是2000年总统选举提名程序的一部分，向总统候选人分配民主党全国代表大会的58个代表名额。波多黎各是美国领地而非州，因此不能参加当年总统正式大选，但仍同样参与总统党团会议和初选。

en.t: Second Intifada: Palestinian militants sought refuge from advancing Israeli forces in the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem, beginning a month-long siege
en.s: From 2 April to 10 May 2002, the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem in the West Bank was besieged by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), targeting suspected Palestinian militants who had taken shelter in the church. As part of Operation Defensive Shield, the IDF occupied Bethlehem and attempted to capture suspected Palestinian militants. Dozens of them fled into the Church of the Nativity and sought refuge.

zh.t: 第二次巴勒斯坦大起义期间伯利恒圣诞教堂遭围困
zh.s: 2002年4月2日至5月10日，以色列国防军围困了约旦河西岸伯利恒的圣诞教堂，目标是躲入教堂的巴勒斯坦武装分子。以军在“防御盾牌行动”期间占领伯利恒，并试图抓捕被怀疑为武装分子的人员。数十人逃进圣诞教堂寻求庇护。

en.s: The Battle of Nasiriyah was fought between the US 2nd Marine Expeditionary Brigade and Iraqi forces from 23 March to 2 April 2003 during the US-led invasion of Iraq. On the night of 24–25 March, the bulk of the Marines of Regimental Combat Team 1 passed through the city over the bridges and attacked north towards Baghdad.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sri Lanka on 2 April 2004. The ruling United National Party of Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe was defeated, winning only eighty two seats in the 225-member Sri Lankan parliament. The opposition United People's Freedom Alliance won 105 seats. While this was eight seats short of an absolute majority, the Alliance was able to form a government.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2004年4月2日举行议会选举。总理拉尼尔·维克勒马辛哈领导的执政党统一国民党败选，在225个议席中仅取得82席。反对派统一人民自由联盟赢得105席，虽距绝对多数还差八席，仍得以组阁。

en.s: UFC 47: It's On! was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on April 2, 2004, at the Mandalay Bay Events Center in the Las Vegas suburb of Paradise, Nevada. The event was broadcast live on pay-per-view, and later released on DVD.

zh.s: UFC 47：开战！是终极格斗冠军赛于2004年4月2日在内华达州帕拉代斯市曼德勒海湾活动中心举办的一场综合格斗赛事。赛事通过付费电视直播，之后发行了DVD。

en.s: The Battle of Abu Ghraib was an April 2, 2005 attack on United States forces at Abu Ghraib prison, which consisted of heavy mortar and rocket fire, under which armed insurgents attacked with grenades, small arms, and two vehicle-borne improvised explosive devices (VBIED). The U.S. Military's munitions ran so low that orders to fix bayonets were given in preparation for hand-to-hand fighting.

zh.s: 2005年4月2日，武装叛乱分子袭击阿布格莱布监狱的美军。袭击先以密集迫击炮和火箭弹火力掩护，随后使用手榴弹、轻武器及两辆汽车炸弹进攻。美军弹药一度严重不足，指挥官下令装上刺刀，准备近身搏斗。

en.s: WWE Hall of Fame (2005) was the event which featured introduction of the 6th class to the WWE Hall of Fame. The event was produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) on April 2, 2005, from the Universal Amphitheatre in Los Angeles, California. The event took place the same weekend as WrestleMania 21. The event was hosted by Gene Okerlund.

zh.s: 2005年WWE名人堂仪式是将第六届入选者引入WWE名人堂的活动。世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）于2005年4月2日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的环球露天剧场举办了这场活动。仪式与第二十一届摔角狂热大赛在同一周末举行，由吉恩·奥克伦德主持。

en.s: During the late afternoon and evening of April 2, 2006, a series of tornadoes broke out in the central United States. It was the second major outbreak of 2006, in the same area that suffered considerable destruction in a previous outbreak on March 11 and 12, as well as an outbreak on November 15, 2005.

zh.s: 2006年4月2日下午晚些时候至夜间，美国中部接连出现龙卷风。这是2006年第二次大规模龙卷风过程。同一地区此前在3月11日和12日，以及2005年11月15日，也曾遭龙卷风重创。

en.s: WrestleMania 22 was a 2006 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was the 22nd annual WrestleMania and took place on April 2, 2006, at the Allstate Arena in the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw and SmackDown! brand divisions. There were two main events, which were the main matches for each brand.

zh.s: 第二十二届摔角狂热是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2006年4月2日在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥郊区罗斯蒙特的全州保险竞技场举行，参赛者来自Raw与SmackDown两个品牌。赛事安排两场压轴级比赛，分别作为两个品牌的重点大赛。

en.s: The 2006 Football League Trophy Final was an association football match played on 2 April 2006 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. The match was the 23rd final of the Football League Trophy, the domestic cup competition for teams from Football Leagues One and Two. The final was contested between Swansea City of League One and Carlisle United of League Two.

zh.t: 2006年英格兰足球联赛锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2006年英格兰足球联赛锦标赛决赛于2006年4月2日在加的夫千年球场举行。这是英格兰足球联赛锦标赛第23届决赛，该赛事是英格兰足球甲级联赛和乙级联赛球队参加的国内杯赛。决赛由英甲球队斯旺西城对阵英乙球队卡莱尔联。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Florian vs. Lauzon
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Florian vs. Lauzon (also known as UFC Fight Night 13) was a mixed martial arts (MMA) event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) on April 2, 2008 at the Broomfield Event Center in Broomfield, Colorado.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：弗洛里安对劳宗
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：弗洛里安对劳宗，又称UFC格斗之夜13，是终极格斗冠军赛于2008年4月2日，在美国科罗拉多州布鲁姆菲尔德活动中心举办的综合格斗赛事。

en.t: 2009 Liberal National Party of Queensland leadership election
en.s: The 2009 Liberal National Party of Queensland leadership election was held on 2 April 2009 to elect a new leader of the Liberal National Party of Queensland (LNP) and, ex officio, Leader of the Opposition. Following the LNP's loss at the state election on 21 March 2009, Lawrence Springborg resigned as leader.

zh.t: 2009年昆士兰自由国家党党魁选举
zh.s: 2009年4月2日，昆士兰自由国家党举行党魁选举，选出新党魁；党魁同时自动担任反对党领袖。该党在2009年3月21日州选举中失利后，劳伦斯·斯普林博格辞去党魁职务。

en.s: The Good Friday Engagement took place on April 2, 2010 as part of the Bundeswehr's operation in Afghanistan between a paratrooper unit and members of the Taliban. These were supported by the Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan. Three paratroopers were killed in the engagement. In the engagement, German soldiers were involved in prolonged combat operations with their own losses for the first time since the Second World War.

zh.s: 2010年4月2日，德国联邦国防军在阿富汗执行任务期间，一支伞兵部队与塔利班成员交战，塔利班得到乌兹别克斯坦伊斯兰运动支援。三名德国伞兵阵亡。这是第二次世界大战后，德国军人首次参加持续作战并在其中遭受己方人员死亡。

en.s: In April 2010 Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) held a total of five CMLL Super Viernes shows, all of which took place Arena México on Friday nights. CMLL did not hold any special events on Fridays that would force a cancellation such as a pay-per-view (PPV).

zh.s: 2010年4月2日，墨西哥摔角联盟举办当月首场“超级星期五”赛事；该月共举行五场。

en.t: India wins the Cricket World Cup for the second time in history under the captaincy of MS Dhoni
en.s: The 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup was the tenth Cricket World Cup. It was played in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh, the latter hosting World Cup matches for the first time. India defeated Sri Lanka by six wickets in the final at Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai, thus becoming the first country to win the Cricket World Cup final on home soil.

zh.t: 印度第二次赢得板球世界杯
zh.s: 2011年国际板球世界杯是第十届世界杯赛事，在印度、斯里兰卡和孟加拉国举行。印度在孟买万卡德体育场举行的决赛中以六个三柱门的优势击败斯里兰卡，成为首个在本土赢得板球世界杯决赛的国家。

en.s: On April 2, 2012, 43-year-old One L. Goh killed seven people and injured three others at Oikos University, a Korean Christian college in Oakland, California, United States. It is the deadliest mass killing in the city's history.

zh.s: 2012年4月2日，43岁的高元在美国加利福尼亚州奥克兰的韩裔基督教院校奥伊科斯大学，枪杀七人，打伤三人。按原文记载，这是该市历史上死亡人数最多的大规模杀人事件。

en.s: UTair Flight 120 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Tyumen to Surgut, Russia. On 2 April 2012, the ATR-72 turboprop aircraft operating the flight crashed shortly after take-off from Roschino International Airport, killing 33 of the 43 people on board. Investigation carried out by the Russian Interstate Aviation Committee (MAK) revealed that the aircraft had not been de-iced prior to its take-off, even though it had been parked for hours in snowy condition.

zh.s: UTair航空120号班机原为一班从俄罗斯秋明飞往苏尔古特的定期国内客运航班。2012年4月2日，执行该航班的ATR-72涡桨飞机从罗希诺国际机场起飞后不久坠毁，机上43人中有33人遇难。俄罗斯国家间航空委员会调查发现，飞机在积雪环境中停放数小时后，起飞前没有除冰。

en.t: End of the tenure of Pál Schmitt
en.s: Pál Schmitt (born 13 May 1942) is a Hungarian Olympic fencer and politician who served as president of Hungary from 2010 until his resignation in 2012, following his academic misconduct controversy. Schmitt was a successful fencer in his youth, winning two gold medals at two Summer Olympic Games. Later, he served as an ambassador during the 1990s and was a Vice-President of the European Parliament from 2009 to 2010.

zh.s: 帕尔·施密特（生于1942年5月13日）是匈牙利奥运击剑运动员和政治家，2010年至2012年担任匈牙利总统，后因学术不端争议辞职。他年轻时是成绩出色的击剑运动员，曾在两届夏季奥运会上获得两枚金牌。此后，他于20世纪90年代担任大使，并于2009年至2010年担任欧洲议会副主席。

en.s: The 2013 Kansas City, Kansas mayoral election took place on April 2, 2013, to elect the Mayor/CEO of the United Government of Wyandotte County and Kansas City, Kansas. The election is officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Joe Reardon did not run for a third term. Mark Holland and Ann Murguia were on the ballot in the general election. Holland defeated Murguia by over 1,500 votes.

zh.t: 2013年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城市长选举
zh.s: 2013年4月2日，美国堪萨斯州堪萨斯城举行选举，选出怀恩多特县与堪萨斯城联合政府的市长兼行政首长。选举正式采取无党派形式。现任乔·里尔登不再寻求第三个任期，马克·霍兰德与安·穆尔吉亚进入正式选举，最终霍兰德以超过1500票的优势获胜。

en.s: The 2013 Wisconsin Spring Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on April 2, 2013. There were contested elections for justice of the Wisconsin Supreme Court and Superintendent of Public Instruction, as well as several other nonpartisan local and judicial elections. In addition, the ballot contained a special election to fill a vacancy in the 98th Assembly district.

zh.s: 2013年4月2日，美国威斯康星州举行春季选举。最高法院法官和公共教育总监职位均有竞争，另有多项无党派地方公职及法官选举。选票中还包括填补州众议院第98选区空缺的特别选举。

en.s: The 2013 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 2, 2013 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Francis Slay to a fourth term. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 5.

zh.s: 2013年4月2日，密苏里州圣路易斯举行市长选举。现任市长弗朗西斯·斯雷连任，开始第四个任期。选举前，政党初选已于3月5日举行。

en.s: The 2013 North Las Vegas mayoral election was held on April 2, 2013, to elect the mayor of North Las Vegas, Nevada. It saw the election of John Jay Lee, who defeated incumbent mayor Shari Buck.

zh.s: 2013年4月2日，内华达州北拉斯维加斯举行市长选举。约翰·杰伊·李当选，击败现任市长莎丽·巴克。

en.s: On April 2, 2014, a spree shooting occurred at several locations on the Fort Hood military base near Killeen, Texas. Four people, including the gunman, were killed while 14 additional people were injured; 12 by gunshot wounds. The shooter, 34-year-old Army Specialist Ivan Lopez-Lopez, died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

zh.s: 2014年4月2日，美国得克萨斯州基林附近的胡德堡军事基地多个地点发生连续枪击。包括枪手在内共有四人死亡，另14人受伤，其中12人为枪伤。枪手是34岁的陆军专业军士伊万·洛佩斯-洛佩斯，最后开枪自杀。

en.s: On 2 April 2015, gunmen stormed the Garissa University College in Garissa, Kenya, killing 148 people, and injuring 79 or more. The militant group and Al-Qaeda offshoot, Al-Shabaab, which the gunmen claimed to be from, took responsibility for the attack. The gunmen took over 700 students hostage, freeing Muslims and killing those who identified as Christians. The siege ended the same day, when all four of the attackers were killed. Five men were later arrested in connection with the attack, and a bounty was placed for the arrest of a suspected organizer.

zh.s: 2015年4月2日，枪手闯入肯尼亚加里萨大学学院，杀害148人，造成至少79人受伤。枪手自称来自基地组织分支索马里青年党，该组织也宣称负责。袭击者挟持700多名学生，释放穆斯林，杀害表明自己是基督徒的人。围困于当天结束，四名袭击者全部被击毙。此后五名男子因涉案被捕，警方还悬赏缉拿一名疑似策划者。

zh.s: 世界格斗系列赛30：布兰奇对斯塔克斯，是2016年4月2日在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯硬石酒店赌场举行的综合格斗赛事。

en.s: The Czech Pirate Party leadership election of 2016 was held on 2 April 2016. Ivan Bartoš was elected the new leader. Members of the party were allowed to vote through internet.

zh.s: 2016年4月2日，捷克海盗党举行领导人选举，伊万·巴尔托什当选新领袖。党员可通过互联网投票。

en.s: WWE Hall of Fame (2016) was the event which featured the introduction of the 17th class to the WWE Hall of Fame. en.s: Costa Rica's National Liberation Party presidential primary (or Convención Nacional “National Convention”) was a primary election programmed for April 2, 2017 in order to choose the party's presidential nominee for the 2018 Costa Rican general election. PLN was then the main opposition party to Luis Guillermo Solís' government.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加民族解放党定于2017年4月2日举行总统初选，也称“全国大会”，以确定参加2018年大选的总统候选人。当时，该党是路易斯·吉列尔莫·索利斯政府的主要反对党。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Serbia on 2 April 2017. Incumbent president Tomislav Nikolić was eligible to run for a second five-year term, but opted not to do so. Prime Minister Aleksandar Vučić was elected president in the first round. The election was marred by accusations of voter intimidation and a near total domination of the Serbian media by Vučić and his party.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚于2017年4月2日举行总统选举。现任总统托米斯拉夫·尼科利奇虽有资格竞逐第二个五年任期，但决定不参选。总理亚历山大·武契奇在首轮投票中当选。此次选举受到有关选民遭恐吓的指控影响，武契奇及其政党对塞尔维亚媒体几乎全面占据主导，也引发争议。

en.s: The 2017 EFL Trophy final was an association football match that was played on 2 April 2017 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was played between League One teams Coventry City and Oxford United. The match decided the winners of the 2016–17 EFL Trophy, a 64-team knockout tournament comprising clubs from League One and League Two of the English Football League (EFL), as well as 16 Category One academy sides representing Premier League and Championship clubs.

zh.s: 2017年4月2日，两支英甲球队考文垂与牛津联，在伦敦温布利球场争夺2016—2017赛季英格兰联赛锦标赛冠军。该届淘汰赛共有64支球队参加，包括英格兰足球联赛旗下英甲、英乙俱乐部，以及代表英超和英冠俱乐部的16支一级青训梯队。

en.s: WrestleMania 33 was a 2017 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 33rd annual WrestleMania and took place on April 2, 2017, at Camping World Stadium in Orlando, Florida. Then-active WWE wrestlers The New Day (Big E, Kofi Kingston, and Xavier Woods) served as the hosts of the event.

zh.s: 第三十三届摔角狂热是WWE为主要选手品牌Raw和SmackDown制作的年度职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，于2017年4月2日在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多露营世界体育场举行。当时仍在参赛的“新一天”组合——大E、科菲·金斯顿和泽维尔·伍兹——担任赛事主持。

en.s: General elections were held in Ecuador on 19 February 2017 alongside a referendum on tax havens. Voters elected a new President and National Assembly. Incumbent President Rafael Correa of the PAIS Alliance was not eligible for re-election, having served three terms. In the first round of the presidential elections, PAIS Alliance candidate Lenín Moreno received 39% of the vote.

en.s: The ongoing Ethiopian civil conflict began with the 2018 dissolution of the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF), an ethnic federalist, dominant party political coalition. After the 20-year border conflict between Ethiopia and Eritrea, a decade of internal tensions, two years of protests, and a state of emergency, Hailemariam Desalegn resigned on 15 February 2018 as prime minister and EPRDF chairman, and there were hopes of peace under his successor Abiy Ahmed.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚内战（2018年至今）
zh.s: 仍在持续的埃塞俄比亚内战始于2018年埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线（EPRDF）解散。该联盟是以族群联邦制为基础的执政党联盟。在埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚经历20年边境冲突、国内紧张局势持续十年、抗议活动延续两年并进入紧急状态后，海尔马里亚姆·德萨莱尼于2018年2月15日辞去总理和EPRDF主席职务；其继任者阿比·艾哈迈德上任后，人们一度期待和平到来。

en.s: The 2019 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on Tuesday, April 2, 2019, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. The incumbent justice, Shirley Abrahamson, retired after 43 years on the court, the longest in the history of the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Although the Wisconsin Supreme Court justices are considered nonpartisan, Abrahamson identified as a liberal and voted with the liberal 3–4 minority on the court.

zh.t: 2019年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2019年4月2日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官雪莉·亚伯拉罕森在法院任职43年后退休，是该院历史上任职最久的法官。虽然最高法院法官被视为无党派，她自认自由派，投票时与院内三比四处于少数的自由派站在一起。

en.s: The 2019 Chicago aldermanic election took place in two rounds on February 26 and April 2, 2019, to elect 50 aldermen to the Chicago City Council. Each alderman represents one of Chicago's 50 wards. The elections are non-partisan and use a two-round system where the top two finishers compete in a second-round run-off if no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote in the first round.

zh.s: 2019年2月26日和4月2日，芝加哥分两轮选举50名市议员，每人代表全市50个选区中的一个。选举采用无党派两轮制：若首轮无人获得超过50%的选票，则得票最高的两人进入第二轮决选。

en.s: The 2019 Wisconsin spring election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on April 2, 2019. There was one seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court on the ballot, as well as several other nonpartisan local and judicial elections. There were also a number of local referendums for school funding. The 2019 Wisconsin spring primary was held on February 19, 2019.

zh.s: 2019年4月2日，美国威斯康星州举行春季选举，改选最高法院一个席位，以及多项无党派地方公职和法官职位。另有多项有关学校经费的地方公投。春季初选已于2月19日举行。

en.s: The 2019 Maltese presidential election took place on 2 April 2019. Members of the Parliament of Malta voted in an indirect election to approve the appointment of former cabinet minister George Vella, the only nominee, as President of Malta. Vella's nomination was supported by both the governing Labour Party and opposition Nationalist Party.

zh.s: 马耳他于2019年4月2日举行总统选举，议会议员通过间接投票，批准任命唯一被提名者、前内阁部长乔治·韦拉为总统。其提名同时获得执政工党及反对党国民党支持。

en.s: The 2019 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on April 2, 2019, to elect the Mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. Goodman's main opponent was Republican Phil Collins. Incumbent Mayor Carolyn Goodman, an Independent in office since 2011, was reelected to a third term in office.

zh.s: 2019年4月2日，美国内华达州拉斯维加斯举行市长选举，与其他多项地方选举同期进行。选举正式采用无党派形式。自2011年起任职的独立派现任市长卡罗琳·古德曼，击败主要对手、共和党人菲尔·柯林斯，赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 2019 Brown County, Wisconsin Executive election took place on April 2, 2019. Incumbent County Executive Troy Streckenbach ran for re-election to a third term. Though outgoing Green Bay Mayor Jim Schmitt took out papers to challenge Streckenbach, he ultimately declined to run. Instead, Streckenbach faced former County Supervisor Mark Berndt, a financial advisor. He defeated Berndt in a landslide, winning 75 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2019年威斯康星州布朗县县长选举
zh.s: 2019年4月2日，美国威斯康星州布朗县举行县长选举。现任县长特洛伊·斯特雷肯巴赫寻求第三个任期。即将卸任的格林贝市长吉姆·施密特虽曾领取参选表格，最终决定不参选。斯特雷肯巴赫因此对阵前县议员、财务顾问马克·贝恩特，并以75%的得票率大获全胜。

en.s: The American city of Columbia, Missouri held an election for mayor on April 2, 2019. Incumbent mayor Brian Treece won re-election against former Missouri House member Chris Kelly. Kelly's run for Columbia mayor was the only unsuccessful electoral campaign of his career.

zh.t: 2019年密苏里州哥伦比亚市长选举
zh.s: 2019年4月2日，美国密苏里州哥伦比亚举行市长选举。现任市长布赖恩·特里斯击败前密苏里州众议员克里斯·凯利，成功连任。凯利竞选哥伦比亚市长是他政治生涯中唯一一次未能当选。

en.s: The 2019 Colorado Springs mayoral election was held on April 2, 2019, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado. The election was officially nonpartisan. A runoff had been scheduled for May 21, 2019, but John Suthers received enough votes in the general election. Incumbent mayor Suthers won reelection to a second term.

zh.t: 2019年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举
zh.s: 2019年4月2日，科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯举行市长选举，正式不设党派标签。原定于5月21日举行第二轮选举，但约翰·萨瑟斯在大选中获得足够票数，因此无需第二轮。现任市长萨瑟斯连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2019 Chicago mayoral election was held on February 26, 2019, to determine the next Mayor of the City of Chicago, Illinois. Since no candidate received a majority of votes, a runoff election was held on April 2, 2019, between the two candidates with the most votes, Lori Lightfoot and Toni Preckwinkle. Lightfoot defeated Preckwinkle in the runoff election to become mayor, and was sworn in as mayor on May 20, 2019.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2019年2月26日，芝加哥举行首轮市长选举。由于没有候选人获得多数票，得票最高的两名候选人洛丽·莱特富特和托妮·普雷克温克尔于2019年4月2日参加第二轮选举。莱特富特击败普雷克温克尔，当选市长，并于2019年5月20日宣誓就职。

en.s: On 2 April 2021, at 09:28 NST (01:28 UTC), a Taroko Express train operated by the Taiwan Railways Administration (TRA) derailed at the north entrance of Qingshui Tunnel in Heren Section, Xiulin Township, Hualien County, Taiwan, killing 49 people and injuring at least two others, making it the deadliest railway accident in Taiwan in terms of confirmed deaths.

zh.s: 2021年4月2日台湾时间9时28分（协调世界时1时28分），台湾铁路管理局的一列太鲁阁号列车，在花莲县秀林乡和仁路段清水隧道北口脱轨。原文记载49人死亡、至少两人受伤，并称按确认死亡人数计算，这是台湾最严重的铁路事故。

en.s: On 2 April 2021, Al-Shabaab militants simultaneously attacked Somali National Army bases in Awdheegle and Bariire, Lower Shabelle, killing forty-eight soldiers and dozens of al-Shabaab fighters. Somali forces were able to repulse both attacks.

zh.t: 奥德赫格莱与巴里雷袭击
zh.s: 2021年4月2日，索马里青年党同时袭击下谢贝利地区奥德赫格莱和巴里雷的国民军基地，造成48名士兵及数十名青年党武装人员死亡。索马里部队击退了两处进攻。

en.s: On April 2, 2021, Noah Green, a 25-year-old black nationalist, killed Capitol Police officer William Evans and wounded a second officer after he deliberately rammed his car into a barricade outside the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C. As a result of the attack, the Capitol complex was locked down. Green was shot and later died at a hospital from the gunshot wounds.

zh.s: 2021年4月2日，25岁的黑人民族主义者诺亚·格林，驾车故意撞击华盛顿美国国会大厦外的路障，造成国会警察威廉·埃文斯死亡，另一名警员受伤。袭击后，国会建筑群被封锁。格林遭警员开枪，后来在医院因枪伤死亡。

en.s: Bellator 255: Pitbull vs. Sanchez 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on April 2, 2021 at Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut. The event was Bellator's first of the year following a four-month break after Bellator 254.

zh.t: Bellator 255：比特犬对桑切斯二番战
zh.s: Bellator 255：比特犬对桑切斯二番战，是Bellator MMA于2021年4月2日，在美国康涅狄格州安卡斯维尔莫希根太阳竞技场举办的综合格斗赛事。继Bellator 254后停赛四个月，这是该组织当年的首场赛事。

en.s: On April 2, 2021, insurgents from the al-Qaeda-linked group Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) attacked a contingent of Chadian troops serving in MINUSMA, the UN's peacekeeping branch throughout the Mali War. The Chadian troops effectively repelled the JNIM attack, inflicting heavy casualties.

zh.s: 2021年4月2日，与基地组织有关联的“伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织”（JNIM）武装分子袭击了驻马里的联合国马里多层面综合稳定团（MINUSMA）乍得部队。乍得部队有效击退袭击，并使袭击方遭受重大伤亡。

en.s: The 2022 NXT Stand & Deliver was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the second annual Stand & Deliver held for the promotion's developmental brand NXT. The event took place on April 2, 2022, at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, Texas. The event was held as a part of WrestleMania Weekend, being held the same day as WrestleMania 38 Night 1 with a special start time of 1 p.m.

zh.s: 2022年“NXT挺身而出”是WWE为旗下发展品牌NXT制作的职业摔角网络直播赛事，也是第二届年度“挺身而出”。赛事于4月2日在美国得克萨斯州达拉斯美国航空中心举行，属于摔角狂热周末活动，与第三十八届摔角狂热第一晚在同一天举行，特别提前至下午1点开场。

en.s: The Battle of Kyiv was part of the Kyiv offensive in the Russian invasion of Ukraine for control of Kyiv, the capital city of Ukraine, and surrounding districts including Hostomel Airport. The combatants were elements of the Russian Armed Forces and Ukrainian Armed Forces. The battle lasted from 24 February 2022 to 2 April 2022 and ended with the withdrawal of Russian forces.

zh.s: 基辅之战是俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间基辅攻势的一部分，双方争夺乌克兰首都基辅及周边地区的控制权，范围包括霍斯托梅尔机场。交战双方为俄罗斯武装部队和乌克兰武装部队。战斗从2022年2月24日持续至4月2日，以俄军撤退告终。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 2 April 2023 to elect members of the Parliament of Finland. Following the 2019 election, the Social Democratic Party (SDP) formed a governing coalition with the Centre Party, Greens, Left Alliance, and the Swedish People's Party, with Antti Rinne serving as the prime minister of Finland.

zh.s: 芬兰于2023年4月2日举行议会选举，选出新一届议员。此前2019年选举后，社会民主党与中间党、绿党、左翼联盟和瑞典族人民党组成联合政府，由安蒂·林内担任总理。

en.s: WrestleMania 39, also promoted as WrestleMania Goes Hollywood, was a 2023 two-part professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 39th annual WrestleMania and took place as a two-night event on Saturday, April 1 and Sunday, April 2, 2023, at SoFi Stadium in the Greater Los Angeles city of Inglewood, California.

zh.s: 第三十九届摔角狂热又以“摔角狂热进军好莱坞”为宣传主题，是WWE为主要选手品牌Raw和SmackDown制作的年度职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事。2023年的赛事分两晚举行，分别为4月1日星期六和4月2日星期日，场地是美国加利福尼亚州大洛杉矶地区英格尔伍德的SoFi体育场。

en.s: The 2023 EFL Trophy, known as the Papa Johns Trophy for sponsorship reasons, the 40th season in the history of the competition, is a knock-out tournament for clubs in EFL League One and League Two, the third and fourth tiers of the English football league system, as well as the "Academy teams" of 16 Premier League clubs with Category One status.

zh.s: 2023年4月2日，博尔顿流浪者在伦敦温布利球场以4比0击败普利茅斯阿盖尔，赢得英格兰足球联赛锦标赛。

en.s: The 2024 Connecticut Republican presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 28 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-most basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in New York, Rhode Island, and Wisconsin.

zh.t: 2024年康涅狄格州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年4月2日，康涅狄格州举行共和党总统初选，是2024年总统选举提名程序的一部分。共和党全国代表大会的28个代表名额，按胜者获得大多数名额的规则分配。纽约州、罗得岛州和威斯康星州也在同日举行初选。

en.s: The 2024 Wisconsin Republican presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 41 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-all basis.

zh.t: 2024年威斯康星州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年4月2日，威斯康星州举行共和党总统初选，是2024年总统选举提名程序的一部分。共和党全国代表大会的41个代表名额，全部由胜者取得。

en.s: The 2024 Rhode Island Democratic presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside three other contests on the day. 26 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated, with 9 additional unpledged delegates.

zh.t: 2024年罗得岛州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年4月2日，罗得岛州举行民主党总统初选，是2024年总统选举提名程序的一部分，与另外三场初选同日举行。此次分配民主党全国代表大会的26个代表名额，另有九名不受候选人承诺约束的代表。

en.s: The 2024 Rhode Island Republican presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 19 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-most basis. The contest was held alongside primaries in Delaware, New York, and Wisconsin. Even though Trump cruised to victory, he showed a poorer result as compared to his performance in 2020 (albeit as a non-incumbent), getting almost 3% fewer votes.

zh.t: 2024年罗得岛州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年4月2日，罗得岛州举行共和党总统初选，是2024年总统选举提名程序的一部分。共和党全国代表大会的19个代表名额，按胜者获得大多数名额的规则分配。原文称，特拉华州、纽约州和威斯康星州也在同日举行初选。特朗普虽轻松获胜，但相较2020年竞选时的表现，得票率下降近三个百分点；这次他已不是现任总统。

en.s: Elections for the Senate of Pakistan were held on 2 April 2024. Senate elections in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were postponed by the ECP to 21 July 2025. 52 out of 100 incumbent Senators including 4 FATA senators retired after completing their 6-year terms. After the merger of FATA with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, the remaining 4 out of 8 seats were also abolished. 48 seats from four Provinces and the Federal Capital were up for election, including the seats for which the election was postponed.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2024年4月2日举行参议院选举。选举委员会将开伯尔-普什图省的投票推迟至2025年7月21日。原有100名参议员中，52人六年任期届满，包括四名原联邦直辖部落地区议员。该地区并入开伯尔-普什图省后，其原有八个席位中剩余的四席也被取消。此次应改选四省及联邦首都共48席，包括延期投票的席位。

en.s: The 2024 Wisconsin Democratic presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside three other contests on the day. 82 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated, with 13 additional unpledged delegates. President Joe Biden won almost 90% of the vote and was virtually unopposed, with Dean Phillips and the campaign for uninstructed delegates being his only challengers.

zh.t: 2024年威斯康星州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年4月2日，威斯康星州举行民主党总统初选，是2024年总统选举提名程序的一部分，与另外三场初选同日举行。此次分配民主党全国代表大会的82个代表名额，另有13名不受候选人承诺约束的代表。总统乔·拜登获得近90%的选票，几乎没有实质竞争，仅面对迪恩·菲利普斯及主张选出不表态代表的运动的挑战。

en.s: The 2024 Milwaukee County Executive election took place on April 2, 2024. Incumbent County Executive David Crowley ran for re-election to a second term. His only opponent was activist and perennial candidate Ieshuh Griffin. Because only two candidates filed for the election, no primary election was held. Crowley defeated Griffin in a landslide, winning re-election with 85 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，美国密尔沃基县举行县长选举。现任县长戴维·克劳利寻求第二个任期，唯一对手是活动人士、经常参选的伊舒·格里芬。由于只有两人报名，未举行初选。克劳利以85%的得票率压倒性获胜，成功连任。

en.s: On 2 April 2024, a shooting occurred at the Viertola school, Jokiranta site in Vantaa, Finland. The gunman, a 12-year-old fired a revolver at three students, all aged 12. One victim was killed while two were seriously injured.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，芬兰万塔的维尔托拉学校约基兰塔校区发生枪击。12岁的枪手持左轮手枪，向三名同为12岁的学生开火，造成一人死亡、两人重伤。

en.s: The 2024 New York Republican presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 91 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-most basis. The contest was held alongside the primaries in Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Wisconsin.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，纽约州举行共和党总统初选，作为2024年总统选举共和党提名初选的一部分。91名代表按“胜者得大多数”的规则分配。这场初选与康涅狄格州、罗得岛州和威斯康星州的初选同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 New York Democratic presidential primary was held on April 2, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside contests in three other states. 268 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated, with 39 additional unpledged delegates.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，纽约州举行民主党总统初选，作为2024年总统选举民主党提名初选的一部分，并与另外三个州的初选同期进行。此次初选分配了268名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有39名未承诺代表。

en.s: The 2024 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 2, 2024, with a runoff election on May 14 because no candidate received more than 45% of the vote in the first round. It elected the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. Incumbent Republican mayor Dave Bronson ran for re-election to a second term in office. Bronson and former Anchorage Assembly chair Suzanne LaFrance advanced to the runoff, with LaFrance narrowly placing ahead of Bronson.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，阿拉斯加州安克雷奇举行市长选举。首轮没有候选人得票超过45%，因此于5月14日举行第二轮。现任共和党籍市长戴夫·布朗森竞选连任第二个任期。他与前安克雷奇市议会主席苏珊娜·拉弗朗斯进入第二轮，拉弗朗斯以微弱优势领先布朗森。

en.s: The 2024 Milwaukee mayoral election was held on April 2, 2024, concurrent with other elections during Wisconsin's spring elections, to elect the mayor of Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Incumbent Mayor Cavalier Johnson sought re-election. Johnson won in the largest landslide victory since the 2008 Milwaukee mayoral election. Municipal elections in Wisconsin are nonpartisan. However, all of the candidates in the election were individually affiliated with the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，密尔沃基举行市长选举，与威斯康星州其他春季选举同期进行。现任市长卡瓦利尔·约翰逊寻求连任，并以自2008年密尔沃基市长选举以来最大的优势获胜。威斯康星州的市政选举不设党派标签，但此次所有候选人都各自与民主党有关联。

en.s: On April 2, 2024, Wisconsin held its spring election. The ballot included the Democratic and Republican presidential nominating contests, two uncontested Wisconsin Court of Appeals seats and various nonpartisan local and judicial offices, including county executive and mayoral races in Milwaukee.
en.n: This records the spring election, separate from the November general election.

zh.s: 2024年4月2日，威斯康星州举行春季选举。选票包括民主党和共和党的总统候选人初选、两席无人竞争的州上诉法院席位，以及多项不分党派的地方公职和司法职位，其中有密尔沃基县行政长官和市长选举。
zh.n: 此条记录春季选举，与11月的大选分开。

en.s: The 2024 Polish Super Cup was the 33rd Polish Super Cup, an annual Polish football match played between the reigning winners of the Ekstraklasa and Polish Cup. The Ekstraklasa champions Jagiellonia Białystok faced Polish Cup winners Wisła Kraków. Initially, the Polish Football Association (PZPN) scheduled the match for Sunday, 7 July 2024.

zh.s: 2025年4月2日，原属2024赛季的波兰超级杯在华沙举行，雅盖隆比亚队以1比0击败克拉科夫维斯瓦队夺冠。

en.t: Liberation Day tariffs: U.S. President Donald Trump announces sweeping worldwide tariffs
en.s: United States president Donald Trump announced a broad package of import duties on April 2, 2025—a date he called "Liberation Day". In a White House Rose Garden ceremony, Trump signed Executive Order 14257, Regulating Imports With a Reciprocal Tariff to Rectify Trade Practices That Contribute to Large and Persistent Annual United States Goods Trade Deficits.

zh.t: 解放日关税：美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布全面加征全球关税
zh.s: 2025年4月2日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布一揽子大范围进口关税，并将这一天称为“解放日”。特朗普在白宫玫瑰园举行的仪式上签署了第14257号行政命令《通过对等关税纠正造成美国商品贸易长期、大额年度逆差的贸易行为》。
